title: Sponson release plan (release.plan.yaml)
description: One release, one plan. Specification: docs/plan-format.md. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express (unique ids, references to existing ids, declared environments) are enforced by `sponson plan`.

environments.description: Environments this plan knows. Default: preview, production, plus every environment a line names. `--env` must be one of them.

providers.description: Static configuration per adapter, passed to it as `providers.<adapter>`.

planetscale.description: PlanetScale organization and database (their name slugs). Credentials: PLANETSCALE_SERVICE_TOKEN_ID and PLANETSCALE_SERVICE_TOKEN in the environment.

supabase.description: Supabase project ref (20 lowercase letters) of the parent project: its preview branches and its Auth redirect allow-list.

vercel.description: Vercel project (`prj_…`) and, for team projects, the team id (`team_…`).

clerk.description: Clerk needs no provider configuration; the instance is the one CLERK_SECRET_KEY belongs to.

launchdarkly.description: LaunchDarkly project key and environment key (usually a preview or test environment) whose flag targets the lines manage.

production.description: Whether the environment is production, for Sponson's approval gate (--approved-by). Absent: production when the environment key contains `prod` (any case). Set false for a key such as `preprod` that only looks like one.

http.description: The generic http adapter: one block per API, named by each line's `api:`. Each block is part of its resources' identity.

receipts.description: Receipt store. Default git-branch (orphan branches `sponson-receipts/<env>/<scope>` on the `origin` remote). `--receipts` overrides it.

changes.description: The plan lines. Order in the file does not matter: execution order follows `from:` references and `depends_on`.

id.description: Lowercase: letters, digits, `-` and `_`, starting with a letter.

secretRef.description: A secret reference, resolved only inside Sponson, e.g. `{ secret: "env://NAME" }`. Schemes: docs/plan-format.md#secret-schemes.

keepRef.description: Whatever value the resource has live. Written by `sponson init` when adopting.

value.description: A literal, `{ from }`, `{ secret }` or `{ keep: true }`.

noDisplayText.description: Text `sponson plan` prints for unresolved values must never be written back into the plan.

notSecretLiteral.description: Names ending in _KEY, _SECRET, _TOKEN, PASSWORD, _PASS, PASSWD or PRIVATE (any case) take a `{ secret }` reference, not a literal string or number.

param.description: Any adapter parameter: a literal, a reference, a list, or a map. Applied recursively.

adapter.description: Built in: neon, vercel, clerk, planetscale, launchdarkly, supabase, and http (any JSON REST API described in the plan). Plugins (SPONSON_PLUGINS) add more.

environments.description: Environments this line applies to. Absent: all.

depends_on.description: Ordering without a data dependency. Prefer `from:` references.

paramsOfChange.description: Every key other than id, adapter, op, environments and depends_on is a parameter of the op.

op_neon_branch.description: neon.branch: a Neon branch. Outputs: branch_id, connection_string (sensitive), host.

parent.description: Parent branch name or id. Default: main.

name.description: Branch name. Default: sponson/${ctx.env}/${ctx.scope}. The branch is identified by its name.

op_vercel_env.description: vercel.env: environment variables in one Vercel target (and, for preview, one git branch). Outputs: preview_url and deployment_id, available after the deploy.

target.description: preview, production or development. Default: production when --env production, else preview.

branch.description: Git branch the variables apply to (target preview only). Default: the current branch. `*` means project-wide (every branch).

values.description: NAME: value. A value is a literal, `{ from }`, `{ secret }` or `{ keep: true }`.

op_vercel_deploy.description: vercel.deploy: a deployment of the current commit, made by Sponson. Outputs: preview_url, deployment_id (immediate). Takes no parameters.

op_clerk_redirect_allow.description: clerk.redirect_allow: one allowed redirect URL. Output: id.

url.description: The URL to allow. Usually `{ from: <vercel.env line>.preview_url }`.

op_planetscale_branch.description: planetscale.branch: a development branch of a PlanetScale database, ready before apply returns. Outputs: name, branch_id.

name.description: Branch name. Default: sponson-${ctx.env}-${ctx.scope} (lowercase letters, digits, dashes). The branch is identified by its name.

op_planetscale_password.description: planetscale.password: a password on a PlanetScale branch. Outputs: id, username, host, role; password and connection_string are sensitive and once-only (only in the run that creates the password).

branch.description: The branch, by name. Usually `{ from: <planetscale.branch line>.name }`.

name.description: Password name. Default: sponson-${ctx.env}-${ctx.scope}. A new name creates a new password (a deliberate rotation).

role.description: The password's role. Default: admin. Cannot be changed in place.

connection_params.description: Query of connection_string. Default: ssl={"rejectUnauthorized":true}; Prisma: sslaccept=strict.

envName.description: The NAME of an environment variable, never a value.

credentialEnvName.description: The NAME of the environment variable holding a credential. It must end in TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD, PASSWD, _KEY or APIKEY, so that Sponson masks its value everywhere.

httpApi.description: One API for the http adapter: where it is, and how its credential is sent.

base_url.description: The API's base URL; request paths are relative to it.

base_url_env.description: Optional: a variable that overrides base_url when set (a staging API, the local fake cloud).

auth.description: `{ bearer_env: NAME }`, `{ header: X-Api-Key, value_env: NAME }` or `{ basic: { user_env: NAME, password_env: NAME } }`.

headers.description: Static headers sent with every request (an API version pin).

encoding.description: Request bodies as JSON (default) or application/x-www-form-urlencoded (`a[b]=c`).

production.description: true when the API is a production system (a live Stripe account, a production tenant): every line through it needs approval (--approved-by), whatever the run's environment.

httpPath.description: A path relative to the API's base_url. `{id}` is the object's id; `{name}` is `vars.name`.

jsonPointer.description: A JSON pointer: "" for the whole body, "/data/id" for a field.

httpDestroy.description: What destroying the scope does: delete (default) or keep (leave it in place).

body.description: Extra body fields sent with this request only (not compared).

content_type.description: A media type other than the API's encoding, e.g. application/merge-patch+json.

idempotency_key.description: Create only: send an Idempotency-Key so a create whose answer was lost can be retried.

op_http_resource.description: http.resource: one object per item in a JSON REST API (a flag, a webhook endpoint). Outputs: id, plus those under `outputs`.

api.description: The API: a block under providers.http.

vars.description: Values for `{name}` placeholders in paths: literals or references.

find.description: Locate the object by natural key: a list, the array in it, and the fields that must match.

next.description: Pointer to the next page's cursor in a list response.

cursor_param.description: Query parameter that sends the cursor back. Default: cursor.

read.description: GET the object: by `{id}` after find, or a path that names it.

item_path.description: Where the object is in read, create and update answers. Default: the whole body.

id_path.description: Where the id is in the object. Default: /id.

fields.description: The desired state: field (or /pointer) → value. Compared for drift, sent on create and update.

outputs.description: Output name → JSON pointer into the object, or { path, sensitive: true }.

exists_status.description: Statuses that mean 'already exists' on create, besides 409.

gone_status.description: Statuses that mean 'gone' on read and delete, besides 404.

op_http_list_item.description: http.list_item: one value kept in an array, delimited string or keyed map on a parent object, by read-modify-write. No outputs.

api.description: The API: a block under providers.http.

vars.description: Values for `{name}` placeholders in paths: literals or references.

path.description: The parent object: read with GET, written with `method`.

read_path.description: GET this instead when reading differs from writing.

send.description: field (default): send only the collection; parent: send the whole object back.

list_path.description: Where the collection is in the parent.

shape.description: array (default), delimited (one string, see separator) or map (name → value; null deletes).

item.description: The value (array), the string (delimited) or the entry's name (map).

key_field.description: For map items of an array: the field that identifies the item.

value.description: For shape: map: the entry's value.

op_launchdarkly_flag_target.description: launchdarkly.flag_target: one flag variation served to one context key in the provider block's environment. Outputs: variation_id, variation_name, variation_value.

key.description: The context key to target. Defaults to the scope (pr-42); usually `{ from: <vercel.env line>.preview_url }`.

context_kind.description: The context kind of `key`. Defaults to user.

variation.description: The variation to serve, by name or by value. Defaults to true. `{ keep: true }` keeps the live one.

op_supabase_branch.description: supabase.branch: a Supabase preview branch of the project, waited for until it is up. Outputs: project_ref, api_url, db_host, connection_string (sensitive).

name.description: Branch name. Default: sponson-${ctx.env}-${ctx.scope}. The branch is identified by its name; the project's default branch cannot be named.

op_supabase_auth_redirect.description: supabase.auth_redirect: one URL in the project's Auth redirect allow-list (uri_allow_list). Output: url.

url.description: The URL or wildcard pattern to allow; no commas. Usually `{ from: <vercel.env line>.preview_url }`.

project.description: Ref of the project whose allow-list to edit. Default: providers.supabase.project. A preview branch's own: `{ from: <supabase.branch line>.project_ref }`.
